notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Happy Pride Month. Apologies that I haven't been working on the game for several months until last week.

For the v2022-06-04 update, I have focused more on player feedback (Give your feedback at https://hellist.com/feedback).

Updates:
[list]
[*] Dashing now makes you dodge/invulnerable against non-ground hazards. Thanks r/_Der_Fuchs_ for the idea.
[*] Dashing now costs mana. Thanks Professional Lich#3829's friend for the idea.
[*] Reduce shot speed to make aiming more important than mindless, and slightly improved camera placement (based on mouse position). Thanks FruitLoops#9586 for the suggestion!
[*] Items now have cooldowns and most of them cost mana. Also the dash ability is now part of Aka's Boot Item.
[/list]

In the future:
[list]
[*] Think about other unique/special types of items, and how items can be recharged.
[*] Will add more different NPCs and rooms.
[/list]

Thanks and stay tuned!

notes.title: HELLIST Playtest is now live! (Free)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The first Playtest demo for HELLIST is out - play it free by clicking [b]Request Access[/b]! For best experience, optionally wear headphones but it's not required :).

As it's in the early dev phase, there will be a lot of bugs and tweaking needed - so I will very much appreciate hearing your ideas, feedback, complaints and bugs via Discord [url=https://hellist.com/discord]https://hellist.com/discord[/url]! Thanks so much!

For fun, I've added a few Easter eggs, ordered from easiest to hardest:
[list]
[*] 5x coins
[*] Trust
[*] Cyrillic
[*] 💎🤲
[*] Satan
[*] Run from nightmares (hardest to find)
[/list]

Hopefully the game will come out in a few years time.

The "to do list" is available in https://hellist.com/todo.

Enjoy the demo and have a great week!
- Alan
